review_notes: Inspected preview, 5x crops and all evidence lines. Extraction had merged several references into single items (22-24, 25-27, 31-33, 34-35, 36-37, 38-39; refs 23, 24, 26, 27, 32, 33, 35, 37, 39 were not separate). Rebuilt one text item per reference (14-45 left column, 46-77 right) from evidence lines; original IDs kept for the first reference in each old item, split-off references get suffixes (e.g. p0016-b009a). Numbering verified continuous 14-77 and cross-checked against the publisher reference list. Diacritics repaired (Allgöwer, Schöberl, Krüger, Böhm, González-Segredo, Bäck, Klingmüller); line-wrap joins fixed ("Discreteness-induced", "High-dimensional", "JAK2/STAT5", "189–228", "247–249", "TRAIL-induced"). The source PDF reference font lacks fl/ffi ligature glyphs (renders "ow cytometry", "immunouorescence", "uctuations", "uorescent", "affnity"); kept as printed. Source typos kept (e.g. "Proc Nati Acad", "M P Vecchi MP", "Mol Syst Biol 516"). Header/footers omitted.
